# Script fixtures

`aabb_common.rhai` is an unchanged copy from rusthinq-scripts revision
`54292921c6edc72ea6ec901b1137845bff14e6ae`, licensed under that repository's
GPL-2.0 terms (see its README/COPYING). SHA-256:
`fa6431795f3c6ba58234a59c65dcc02740696336fd89bbd9a9b7ee077abf776c`.

The module test exercises only `bit` and `on_off`. Other helpers require missing
APIs such as framing, property/event output and numeric conversion. This fixture
does not establish real-appliance driver acceptance or complete compatibility.
